$comment: Debated conclusion book. REAL MONEY, own independent £200 bank (methodology.md sections 2 and 4, decided 12 September 2026) — one of three real-money books, not the only one. price_obtained_by_owner and price_obtained_timestamp_utc on each entry must reflect what the owner actually got, never what was showing at selection time. Stop rule (section 2) applies to this book on its own: max 20 bets, review at bet 10, terminates early if any decision changes because of this book's own running P/L.
gameweek_4_note: All four conclusion-book entries settled: Draw lost (-£10), BTTS No won (+£16), Newcastle win lost (-£10), accumulator lost (-£10). Net -£14 for the gameweek. Bank £186/£200.
accounting_note: running_balance_gbp reflects settled results only; stakes on open (unsettled) bets are tracked via bets_placed/bets_remaining and each entry's own fields, not deducted here until result is known.

entries.price_obtained_by_owner_note: Odds 27/10 on Ladbrokes, placed as a '2Up&Win - Early Payout' enhanced single -- the owner confirmed this was accidental (an app/slip mis-tap), not a deliberate product choice, not the plain match-odds Draw the edge above was calculated against. This is a genuinely different product (pays out early under a qualifying in-match condition), typically priced below the plain market as the cost of that feature -- the +3.5/+4.8pp edge figures do not strictly transfer to this product. Recorded honestly as what was actually obtained, per the frozen rule to record the real price, not the modelled one. Process note for future placements: check the bet slip shows the plain market before confirming, since enhanced-product tabs sit right next to the standard one on this bookmaker's app.

entries.decision_reason: Discretionary accumulator combining this book's own three taken selections, permitted under methodology.md section 12 as amended 13 September 2026. Not itself edge-gated -- no combined-edge threshold exists yet (flagged OPEN in section 12). The treble itself was a deliberate choice ('for good measure'); the odds boost applied on top (26.89/1 -> 29.20/1) was not -- the owner confirmed he didn't realise what the boost was and clicked it without understanding it, part of the same single mishap as the 2Up&Win product on the Draw leg/single, not a second separate incident. Doesn't change the settled result (dead once the Draw leg lost), but the record shouldn't read as if the boost were a considered choice either.
entries.result_note: Dead as soon as the Draw leg lost (Brighton won 5-0) -- an accumulator needs every leg to win. Leeds v Newcastle hasn't been played yet, but nothing that fixture does can change this outcome. Official bookmaker settlement will lag until that leg concludes; this repo records it as lost now since the result is already mathematically certain.

entries.actual_lineup_check_note: FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED HERE: this check ran retroactively, after the bet -- this entry's price_obtained_timestamp_utc shows placement at 2026-09-13T13:01:00Z, over an hour before this check. Methodology.md section 6 (decided 13 Sept 2026) requires a provisional selection to be re-checked against the confirmed lineup BEFORE placement, precisely so a live-money bet is never staked on unconfirmed team news -- that sequencing did not happen here. Recording what the retroactive check found, for the record, but this does not cure the process gap: official lineups (confirmed ~55min pre-kickoff -- see collaboration/claude-input.json for the full comparison) matched pre-match assumptions with no material change, and BTTS No's edge recomputed against the refreshed market is unchanged (Claude +6.51pp, Codex +5.91pp), still clearing the 3pp threshold. Decision, stake, price_obtained_by_owner and status are left untouched -- this was a real-money bet already placed and cannot be undone or retroactively 'declined'. Raised to the owner as a fail-closed sequencing violation to review, not something resolved unilaterally here.
